gen-gf-grandstander-gf-noto-sans-vai: Noto Sans Vai reads as solid, friendly blocks of text, not jagged skylines. Grandstander headlines in bold, pen-like lines, and over a full page the generous curves keep the paragraphs moving smoothly.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-noto-sans-vithkuq: Noto Sans Vithkuqi brings open-throated letters and barely any capital-to-lowercase step, behind bold Grandstander headings drawn in one line width. Sign-shop sturdiness up top, quiet clarity below: that is the draw.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-noto-sans-wancho: Noto Sans Wancho reads hulking and chalky, its lowercase pressed hard, with an e that leaves a wide gap at the end. Grandstander makes the bold statement; Noto Sans Wancho does the heavy lifting underneath.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-noto-sans-yi: Round and bold: Grandstander draws its bowls with walls of unchanging thickness, unlike the body below. And across a full column, Noto Sans Yi keeps a deep lowercase midsection and unsealed rounds that read smoothly.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-noto-sans-zanabaz: Noto Sans Zanabazar Square soars with a tall x-height and wide gaps beside Grandstander, whose single-weight headings have an outline feel. Big personality up top, crisp tiny sizes below: that's the pair's best trick.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-numans: Loud and loose: Grandstander holds a constant-width pen line with open, uncurled letters. Numans does the quieter job, with widely tracked, rope-thick lowercase and an s whose ends hang far from the spine.
gen-flavors-gf-questrial: Stubby, towering pencil strokes: Flavors announces itself with diagonals carrying full stem weight. Questrial is the flat, stencil-cut counterweight, its open shapes and single-weight strokes keeping the whimsy in check.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-parkinsans: Bold, expressive Grandstander headings meet a crisp, tidy body underneath. Parkinsans keeps one stroke thickness throughout, with wide-mouthed letters that hold up when shrunk and a lowercase nearly as tall as capitals.
gen-almendra-display-gf-anek-malayalam: Anek Malayalam reads crisp and contemporary, with curve tips that never touch and barely any step from capitals to lowercase. Almendra Display brings the ornate, literary flourish; the body keeps things clear.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-yaldevi: Autour One keeps stems and crossbars at one thickness, with a clear channel into each round letter. Yaldevi then runs outsized lowercase with a clearly open e, which keeps longer paragraphs flowing.
